user.title: Connect Dominion SC account
user.description: Enter your Dominion Energy South Carolina credentials.

2fa_method.title: Two-factor authentication
2fa_method.description: Choose where to send your verification code.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Dominion SC Energy
reconfigure.description: Update your credentials and re-authenticate. If your username and password are unchanged, 2FA may be skipped.

error.twofa_post_auth_failed: Verification succeeded, but account setup failed. Check Home Assistant logs for details and retry.

init.title: Dominion SC options
init.description: Adjust integration polling and backfill behavior.

data_description.poll_minutes: How often to poll Dominion for new data (in minutes).
data_description.backfill_cycles_target: Number of most recent completed billing cycles to backfill. Increasing this adds unfilled cycles to the backfill queue.
data_description.daily_lookback_days: Number of days to look back during daily reconciliation to catch late-arriving data.
